label: preparing
what: Likely a community supper and service acknowledgement involving the mayor at the great hall at day 1, 18:00, initially presented to him as a routine lighting inspection. Builder coordinated the hall visit and escort; innkeeper was identified as hospitality coordinator; baker assisted with routing freight to innkeeper. Neighbour knowingly solicited food and agreed to escort the mayor for the acknowledgement; freight was designated to receive donations. The precise event and degree of concealment are not established: the mayor was told about the supper and acknowledgement before the end of the record. No evidence establishes that secretary knowingly helped conceal an event, or that any bridge or port change was being prepared.
